pink.observed: Small pastel-pink plush, upright ears with unequal inclination/projected length, ivory muzzle, broad pink nose and glossy black bead eyes. Paler chest/feet. No invented name.

taupe.observed: Larger warm taupe/grey plush. Broad rounded head, black bead eyes, small pink nose, long broad hanging ears, soft limbs; no white muzzle patch.

ring.observed: Rose-tone narrow band, pink heart-like central stone, bright small stones around setting and shoulders. No physical size, metal certification or exact model inferred. F6 not implemented.

box.observed: Pink hinged box, warm lights, dark letter pennants, large taupe plush on left and pink plush on right in supplied open-box views. Ring placement unconfirmed.
